The checker example below is materialized from the verified frozen Canonical Analysis Parquet v1 reference package. Its cached Backgammonboard SVGs are presentation assets for the same factual GNU position. The cube and loader-failure cases remain deliberately synthetic. The browser still loads only analysis-view JSON. Retained and future Canonical Parquet records are materialized before the browser boundary, and Backgammonboard renders candidate move-overlay SVGs at build time.

:::
